report.metric: Distance 0 (identical) to 1, the mean of six parts measured from the notes each tune plays in its first 90 s after GO: tempo, drums (kick and snare step patterns, hat density, break share), bass (rhythm and pitch classes), harmony (chord transitions and how often they change), melody (rhythm, interval shapes, how much of the time it plays, shared three-interval figures) and instruments (the set of sounds that play).

templates.drums: metal (double kick in eighths and sixteenths, ride, toms)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, A 8, breakdown 8, build 8
templates.p45: Double kick in eighths and sixteenths, guitar chugs locked to the kick, strings holding the phrygian chords above.

templates.name: Tabla Psy
templates.source: Eric: psy with Indian influences; 145 E phrygian
templates.drums: psytrance (kick on every beat; DUH-duh-duh-duh with the bass)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, A 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, B 8, breakdown 8, build 4
templates.sidechain: bass ducked fully under each kick (60 ms), pads -6 dB
templates.p45: The KBBB groove with two tabla layers and a sitar riff; a tanpura drone in the breakdowns.

templates.name: Silk Road
templates.source: Eric: psy with Chinese influences; 142 A minor pentatonic
templates.drums: psytrance (kick on every beat; DUH-duh-duh-duh with the bass)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, A 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, B 8, breakdown 8, build 4
templates.sidechain: bass ducked fully under each kick (60 ms), pads -6 dB
templates.p45: An erhu phrase and its answer in the pentatonic over the KBBB bass, guzheng arpeggios with bends.

templates.name: Night Raga
templates.source: Eric: psy with sitar; 148 C# phrygian dominant, night
templates.drums: psytrance (kick on every beat; DUH-duh-duh-duh with the bass)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, A 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, B 8, breakdown 8, build 4
templates.sidechain: bass ducked fully under each kick (60 ms), pads -6 dB
templates.p45: Dark and fast: a phrygian-dominant sitar riff, the didgeridoo breathing in the breakdowns, zaps.

templates.name: Morning Bansuri
templates.source: Eric: psy with Indian influences; 138 D mixolydian, morning
templates.drums: progressive trance (rims, soft hats)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, A 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, B 8, breakdown 8, build 4
templates.sidechain: bass ducked fully under each kick (60 ms), pads -6 dB
templates.p45: Brighter and rolling: a long bansuri melody in mixolydian over a progressive rolling bass, guzheng arps, the pump under a warm pad.

templates.name: Raga Roller
templates.source: Eric: sitar, Indian influences; DnB rollers
templates.drums: drum & bass roller
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, A 8, breakdown 8, build 8
templates.p45: A roller with a sitar riff, a tabla layer and a seven-voice reese; tanpura in the breakdowns.

templates.name: Liquid Erhu
templates.source: Eric: Chinese influences; liquid at 172
templates.drums: liquid drum & bass (shuffled hats, shaker, ride)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, A 8, breakdown 8, build 8
templates.p45: A long erhu melody over ninth chords, guzheng arps, brushes and a ride.

templates.name: Bansuri Dub
templates.source: Eric: Indian influences, hang drum; 140 G minor
templates.drums: half-time (kick on 1 and the and of 3, snare on 3)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, A 8, breakdown 8, build 8
templates.p45: A bansuri phrase and its answer over half-time drums and a syncopated dub sub (Gm9, Cm9, F, Bbmaj7); the hang drum in the breakdowns.

templates.name: Hang Garden
templates.source: Eric: hang drum and didgeridoo; 96 D minor pentatonic
templates.drums: swung boom-bap
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, A 8, breakdown 8, build 8
templates.p45: The slowest new template: a hang drum ostinato over a swung beat and ninth chords; the didgeridoo in the breakdowns.

templates.name: Didge Stomp
templates.source: Eric: didgeridoo; 126 F minor
templates.drums: techno four-on-the-floor (closed hats with offbeat accents, clap, rims)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, A 16, breakdown 8, build 4, drop 16, switch-up 16, breakdown 8, build 4
templates.p45: Tribal techno: the didgeridoo plays a rhythmic drone riff over a rumbling kick, frame drum and darbuka layers.

templates.name: Erhu Drift
templates.source: Eric: Chinese influences; wave phonk at 140
templates.drums: drift phonk (808 four-on-the-floor, hats at hard and soft velocities, rolls)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, A 8, breakdown 8, build 8
templates.p45: Drift phonk with an erhu singing the hook over a reese and extended chords.

templates.name: Midnight Wave
templates.source: Wave phonk (Eric: built for it); 125 B minor with the guide's extended voicings
templates.drums: phonk / trap (808 kick, half-time clap, rolling hats)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, A 8, breakdown 8, build 8
templates.p45: Bell arpeggios through a dotted echo over Bm9, Gmaj7, Em11, F#7b9; rhodes chords in the breakdowns; sliding 808s.

templates.name: Glass Coast
templates.source: Wave phonk; 105 F# minor, slow
templates.drums: half-time (kick on 1 and the and of 3, snare on 3)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, A 8, breakdown 8, build 8
templates.p45: The slowest phonk: one long soft melody over ninth chords, deep in the reverb.

templates.name: Modal Friction
templates.source: RACE 201: 172 F minor, Fm-E modal friction, three-band reese
templates.drums: neurofunk (snare a hair behind the grid, ghosts ahead, break chops)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, A 8, breakdown 8, build 8
templates.p45: No melody: a seven-voice reese grinding between F minor and E, dark drone pads, the neurofunk groove with break chops.

templates.name: Melancholy Chaos
templates.source: RACE 202: 175 C minor, Cm-Ab-Fm-G7, orchestral strings over amen chops in sevens and fives
templates.drums: breakcore in odd groupings (sevens and fives) with gabber kicks
templates.structure: drop 16, DRUMS ONLY 8, B 16, breakdown 8, build 4, drop 16, DRUMS ONLY 8, switch-up 8, breakdown 8, build 4
templates.p45: Strings holding a minor classical progression while the amen is re-cut in odd groupings, with gabber kick bursts and timpani into the drops.

templates.name: Velvet 120
templates.source: Tempo variety: deep house at 120, E dorian
templates.drums: house (clap on 2 and 4, closed offbeat hats, shaker)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, A 8, breakdown 8, build 8
templates.sidechain: quarter-note pump on pads and lead, bass -11 dB
templates.p45: Em9 to A9 on rhodes, a round deep bass, congas, the pump under a warm pad.

templates.name: Hard Pressure
templates.source: Tempo variety: hard techno at 145, A minor
templates.drums: hard techno (clean: clap, sixteenth hats, rims)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, A 16, breakdown 8, build 4, drop 16, switch-up 16, breakdown 8, build 4
templates.p45: Rumbling kick bass at 145, metallic FM stabs, a cymbal swell into each drop.

templates.name: Trance Breaks
templates.source: Fusion: a breakbeat's rhythm under trance colour at 138 (the old trance-breaks idea, done with arps instead of a constant hook)
templates.drums: Think-style funk break, chopped (re-played)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, A 8, breakdown 8, build 8
templates.p45: A funk break re-cut lightly, an offbeat trance bass, supersaw arps through a dotted echo and pumping pads.

templates.name: Acid Phonk
templates.source: Fusion: drift phonk's drums and cowbell with techno's 303
templates.drums: drift phonk (808 four-on-the-floor, hats at hard and soft velocities, rolls)
templates.structure: drop 16, B 16, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 16, switch-up 8, A 8, breakdown 8, build 8
templates.p45: An acid line written fresh each tune is the bass; the 808 cowbell answers on the offbeats over the phonk stomp.
